answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Port security pass tenure with gate entry logs is the check: entries logged at one port gate for years. The price is per head, and the timber test proves it: A farm faking 209 aliases needs 209 separate entry logs, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The zephyr trail is public, the jetty check is cheap to run, and a farm of 209 aliases pays 209 full fares while the honest agent pays one.
